craft_notes: Sthāyin: Bhairavī-being close. Rows: see, fare, attain. Rejected: clarifying cātikālam — killed: flagged junction. Read aloud: closing coronation.

lines: the shape faring there and past-time withal,
with forth-stand-back wheels ever-yoked — Bhairavī-state attains.
l4.sanskrit_cite: saṃvidrūpasyātmanaḥ prāṇaśaktiṃ paśyan rūpaṃ tatragaṃ cātikālam sākaṃ sṛṣṭisthemasaṃhāracakrair nityodyukto bhairavībhāvam eti
